connector.name: Gitlab MCP Server by dubuqingfeng
connector.registryDescription: GitLab MCP (Model Context Protocol) server for AI agents
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package gitlab-mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the dubuqingfeng account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: GITLAB_TOKEN
env.description: Your API key for the gitlab

env.name: LARK_SECRET_KEY
env.description: 可选：签名密钥（如果机器人启用了签名验证）

env.name: LARK_ENABLE_NOTIFICATION
env.description: 可选：是否启用通知，默认为 true

env.name: GITLAB_NOTE_MODE
env.description: 可选：通知模式 - gitlab_only(仅GitLab)、lark_only(仅Lark)、both(两者都发)，默认为 gitlab_only
